# Brush — Comprehensive Product, Brand & Architecture Guide (LLMs Full Context)

> Official website: https://www.brush-art.in  
> Brand: Brush (Brush Art Store)  
> Country of Origin: India  
> Primary fulfillment studio: Patna, Bihar, India  
> Pan-India shipping partner: DTDC Express (Pan-India Air & Surface)  
> Inquiries & support: support@brush-art.in | WhatsApp/Call: +91-9234755686  

---

## 1. Brand Mission & Core Identity
Brush is an independent Indian design studio and direct-to-consumer print commerce brand founded to provide gallery-quality, museum-grade aesthetic wall decor, posters, apparel, and lifestyle art at accessible Indian pricing. 

Unlike mass-market glossy posters that wrinkle, reflect harsh room lighting, and fade over time, every Brush print is crafted on heavyweight 300 GSM rigid archival matte art board using calibrated 12-color giclée pigment printing.

Brush operates a curated catalog of 538+ products spanning 29 collections, ranging from museum-grade fine art prints and retro cinema one-sheets to oversized streetwear and digital scalable vectors.

---

## 2. Core Product Catalog & Specifications

### A. Archival Art Posters (Single Prints)
- **Paper Stock**: 300 GSM Heavyweight Archival Art Card.
- **Finish**: Anti-Glare Silky Velvet Matte (zero reflection under spotlights or ambient bulb light).
- **Inks**: 12-color archival giclée inks for deep obsidian blacks, rich shadow separation, and vivid color reproduction.
- **Sizes Available**:
  - **A5**: 14.8 × 21.0 cm (5.8 × 8.3 in) — Desk setups, mood boards, compact corners. Starting at ₹29.
  - **A4**: 21.0 × 29.7 cm (8.3 × 11.7 in) — Standard bedroom and gallery wall scale. Starting at ₹49.
  - **A3**: 29.7 × 42.0 cm (11.7 × 16.5 in) — Statement focal piece for living rooms and studios. Starting at ₹89.
  - **12 × 18 inches / 13 × 19 inches**: Select cinema and exhibition sizes.
- **Frame Options**:
  - **Unframed**: Precision-cut frame-ready print, shipped flat or in reinforced crush-proof postal tubes. Fits off-the-shelf IKEA, Amazon, and local Indian frames without trimming.
  - **Gallery Framed**: Encased in sleek matte-black composite moulding with shatter-resistant crystal-clear acrylic face and pre-attached saw-tooth hanging hardware.

### B. Custom Wall Setup Packs (Build Your Own Pack — BYOP)
- **URL**: https://www.brush-art.in/build-pack/
- **Concept**: Interactive multi-select collage kit builder allowing customers to hand-pick exact posters from across all 20+ genres and mix sizes freely within a discounted bundle.
- **Pack Sizes**:
  - **5-Poster Pack**: Ideal for bedroom desk setups and mini gallery grids.
  - **10-Poster Pack**: Complete gallery wall setup (hero scale).
  - **15-Poster Pack**: Multi-room curation or extensive aesthetic wall coverage.
  - **20-Poster Pack**: Full studio, dorm, or cafe wall transformation.
- **Pricing**: Dynamic calculation based on selected sizes (A5/A4/A3) and framing choices, providing 40% to 65% volume savings compared to single poster purchases.

### C. 3-Poster Split Sets & Gallery Collage Kits
- **URL**: https://www.brush-art.in/shop/wall-setup-packs/
- **Design**: Panoramic triptychs where a single expansive artwork spans across three aligned A3/A4 posters, as well as 10, 15, 20, and 25-poster pre-curated collage kits.

### D. Metal Posters
- **URL**: https://www.brush-art.in/shop/metal-posters/
- **Specs**: Printed on 1.2mm aerospace-grade aluminum plates with ultra-durable heat-infused sublimation coating. Magnet-mounted or stand-off wall mounting, scratch and water resistant. India's premier Displate alternative.

### E. Graphic Streetwear Apparel
- **URL**: https://www.brush-art.in/shop/t-shirts/ and https://www.brush-art.in/shop/hoodies/
- **T-Shirts**: 220–240 GSM 100% Super-Combed Cotton, bio-washed, pre-shrunk, drop-shoulder relaxed street fit.
- **Hoodies**: 380–400 GSM Heavyweight Brushed Fleece, ribbed cuffs, kangaroo pocket, double-lined hood (featuring popular drops like the Moon Thief Hoodie).

### F. Waterproof Vinyl Stickers
- **URL**: https://www.brush-art.in/shop/stickers/
- **Specs**: UV-cured waterproof matte vinyl with residue-free adhesive. Dishwasher-safe and scratch-resistant for laptops, water bottles, iPads, and skateboards.

### G. 4K Digital Assets & Scalable Vectors
- **URL**: https://www.brush-art.in/buy-digital-assets/
- **Specs**: 3840 × 2160 Ultra-HD desktop and mobile wallpapers, plus scalable vector graphic assets (SVG/EPS/PNG) with instant high-speed download access.

### H. Current Promotions & Offers
- **Buy 5 Get 1 Free**: Automatic milestone offer applied in cart whenever 5 posters are selected.
- **Free Pan-India Delivery**: Automatically applied on all orders above ₹599.

## 3. Curated Genres & Collections (538+ Products)
Brush organizes 538+ artworks into 29 distinct collections:

1. **Original Movie Posters (116+ prints)**: Vintage cinema one-sheets, Nolan epics (Interstellar, Oppenheimer, Inception, Tenet), Tarantino classics, Dune 2, Blade Runner, Batman, Pulp Fiction. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/original-movie-posters/)
2. **Anime & Manga (48+ prints)**: Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen, Berserk, Evangelion, Akira, Attack on Titan, Studio Ghibli, One Piece Zoro bounty prints, Chainsaw Man. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/anime-posters/)
3. **Typography, Quotes & Pop Art (40+ prints)**: Minimalist philosophy, brutalist Swiss grids, Billie Jean King "Pressure is a Privilege", "Tax Me Daddy", "Menu Fuck Ni Penda", and the 15 new Pop Art releases (Chill Kar Bro, Good Vibes Only Cool Cat, A Little Delulu, Blockbuster, Chai Se Badi Koi Therapy Nahi, Zero Fucks Given, Mauj Mein Raho, Bas Bahut Hua). (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/typography-posters/)
4. **Pop Culture & Music (45+ prints)**: Iconic album song boards (Arctic Monkeys, Tyler the Creator, Frank Ocean, The Weeknd), cult cinema icons, Mickey Mouse Boom aviator print. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/pop-culture-posters/)
5. **Motivation & Mindset (35+ prints)**: Gym motivation, financial discipline, hustle mindset, daily affirmations. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/motivation-posters/)
6. **Gaming (30+ prints)**: Cyberpunk 2077, Elden Ring, Hollow Knight, Valorant, retro gaming art. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/gaming-posters/)
7. **Travel & Mid-Century (25+ prints)**: Vintage travel and city map prints in flat, confident mid-century railway poster palettes. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/travel-posters/)
8. **Wall Setup Packs (25+ packs)**: Pre-curated 10, 15, 20, and 25-poster kits and 3-piece triptychs. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/wall-setup-packs/)
9. **Minimalist & Scandinavian (23+ prints)**: Clean geometry, abstract lines, serene negative space. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/minimalist-posters/)
10. **Floral & Botanical (22+ prints)**: Vintage botanical specimen studies, Lily Mundus Renovatur, organic floral illustrations. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/floral-posters/)
11. **F1 & Motorsports (11+ prints)**: Formula 1 circuits, Kimi Antonelli Mercedes F1, Lewis Hamilton, Fernando Alonso Aston Martin, Ayrton Senna. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/f1-posters/)
12. **Space & Sci-Fi (11+ prints)**: NASA mission charts, James Webb deep-space vistas, Earth cosmic galaxy, sci-fi landscapes. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/space-sci-fi-posters/)
13. **Mythological & Sacred (13+ prints)**: Ancient Indian iconography, Mahadev, Hanuman, cosmic mandalas in modern graphic interpretations. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/mythological-posters/)
14. **Sports (10+ prints)**: Football GOATs, World Cup legends, racing icons. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/sports-posters/)
15. **Digital Assets (46+ vectors & wallpapers)**: Scalable vector art downloads including Shinchan Cheerful Wave, Artisan Burger, Oggy & the Cockroaches, 4K wallpapers. (https://www.brush-art.in/buy-digital-assets/)
16. **Streetwear Hoodies & T-Shirts**: Moon Thief Hoodie, premium drop-shoulder graphic apparel. (https://www.brush-art.in/shop/hoodies/ and https://www.brush-art.in/shop/t-shirts/)
17. **Tapestries, Wallpapers & Stickers**: Woven wall hangings, peel-and-stick wallpaper, waterproof vinyl sheets.

## 4. Ordering, Shipping & Guarantees
- **Delivery Geography**: 100% Pan-India delivery covering 28,000+ pincodes.
- **Courier Partner**: DTDC Express with real-time end-to-end tracking (https://www.brush-art.in/track/).
- **Dispatch SLA**: Printed, quality-audited, and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours of order confirmation.
- **Delivery Timeline**:
  - Orders within Delhi NCR: 5–8 working days.
  - Orders in Other States of India: 6–11 working days (delivery time may vary depending upon shipping address).
- **Free Delivery Policy**: Free shipping automatically applied on all orders above ₹599.
- **Zero Transit Damage Risk**: If any print or frame sustains transit damage, Brush provides a 100% free immediate replacement upon sharing an unboxing video.
- **Payment Methods**: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Debit/Credit Cards, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) on eligible orders.
